name: pocket-pong
description: Pocket Pong: classic Pong for phones, tablets and computers. Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework.

scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
